## Introduction

- An Analytics COE of an organization helps to drive and accelerate the design and execution of Analytics & AI capabilities to showcase measurable value and business impact. It also enables streamlined delivery of Analytics capabilities to conceptualize, build, and deliver robust Analytics products to meet the needs of the business.
- ABC Corp 's Analytics Center of Excellence (ACOE) drives innovation in data management, analysis and reporting. Its overarching goal is to enable data-driven decision making, focus on time-to-value, and maximize benefits that various platforms, knowledge and solutions can bring.
- Building a mature data and analytics setup is a necessary step to achieve the goals of business. Leveraging data as a strategic asset will increase the effectiveness, facilitate oversight, and promote transparency.

## New Request Management -Process Set-Up

<!-- image -->

## Request Submission

- Business teams (lubes, LIG, Application teams, etc..) submits new project via email with supporting documents or attachments to Sudhakar sir.

## Preliminary Review

- RRR along with Business Analyst and Functional team gathers requirements to assess the feasibility, alignment and priority
- Request is approved and priority assigned.

## Team Engagement

- Business Team connects with client to refine scope and expectations.
- Establishes clarity before documentation begins.

## Documentation & Estimation

- Business Analyst prepares BRD/SDD (requirements, As-Is & To-Be flows).
- Tech Team provides a high-level effort and time estimate.

## Client Validation & Approval

- Business team reviews BRD/SDD and estimation.
- Provides signoff to move into execution.

## Delivery Phases

- Structured execution in stages:
- Development (DEV) -Build/configure solution
- UAT -Client validates solution
- Implementation -Rollout into production

## AI Enabled Chatbot -Features and Benefits

<!-- image -->

## KEY BENEFITS

## Enhanced Experience

End user is provided  with a unique experience and ease of usage as the chatbot provides conversational experience

## Scalable & efficient

The chatbot is  scalable to other use cases such as tender doc / content retrieval, Summarization of large documents, etc..

## Ease of Integration

In addition to analyzing and generating knowledge, agent systems can use tools and communicate across a broader digital ecosystem

## Reduced manual effort

By delivering actionable insights quickly, Agentic AI chatbot  enables adaption to changes in preferences and human dynamics, ultimately leading to cost reductions

## Self-learning

By tapping short- and long-term contextual memory resources that are often unavailable in a pre-trained language model, AI agents can rapidly improve their output quality over time.

## Data Quality Initiative -Customized Hybrid Solution (1/2)

## Gen AI

Leverage Gen AI -based solutions for automated IT data quality checks, enabling efficient anomaly detection and rule discovery.

## KEY BENEFITS

## Comprehensive coverage

IT, Business, and Contextual Data Quality addressed through specialized tools.

## Scalable & efficient

## DQX

Utilize Databricks DQX for Business and Contextual Data Quality, ensuring that domain-specific rules, validations, and contextual relevance are addressed effectively.

## Continuous improvement

Gen AI accelerates detection of anomalies, while DQX enforces business and context rules systematically

Hybrid approach allows iterative enhancements and adaptive quality controls.
